caseName: Tenn. Wine & Spirits Retailers Ass'n v. Blair
caseNameFull: TENNESSEE WINE AND SPIRITS RETAILERS ASSOCIATION v. Zackary W. BLAIR, Interim Director of the Tennessee Alcoholic Beverage Commission
